  - region "Simple English explanation of Periodic Functions":
    - paragraph: In simple English
    - heading "Understand Periodic Functions" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "A periodic function repeats after a fixed period T, so f(x+T)=f(x). sin x has T=2π, tan x has T=π, and a merely wavy graph without exact repeat is not periodic. A useful rule is Period rule: f(x+T)=f(x). You can learn Periodic Functions by trying one small example instead of long theory."
    - paragraph: "Measure the horizontal length of one exact cycle and verify the next cycle matches. Example: What is the period of sin(x) in radians? The sine pattern repeats after 2pi. So sin(x+2pi)=sin(x). So the answer is 2pi."
    - paragraph: "In real life, clock hands: Positions repeat every 12 hours. Watch out: Calling a non-repeating wave periodic. The pattern must repeat exactly."
    - complementary:
      - generic: Try this example
      - paragraph: What is the period of sin(x) in radians?
      - generic "Compare your answer"
